description.fallback: Polnareff calls Joseph and Avdol's room, warning them about Devo the Cursed, but is unaware of the razor-wielding doll under his bed. After setting a meeting with his group, Polnareff then calls the hotel's room service for anti-inflammatory medicine and bandages for his ankle injury. Meanwhile, Avdol thinks Polnareff may have been tricked by Devo.

intro.fallback: Polnareff calls Joseph and Avdol's room, warning them about Devo the Cursed, but is unaware of the razor-wielding doll under his bed.
After setting a meeting with his group, Polnareff then calls the hotel's room service for anti-inflammatory medicine and bandages for his ankle injury.
Meanwhile, Avdol thinks Polnareff may have been tricked by Devo.

outro.fallback: It then saws the foot of the bed, which crushes Polnareff under its weight, but a man with medical supplies for Polnareff arrives and is quickly killed by the demonic doll.
Polnareff tries to fight with Silver Chariot but is unable to properly hit his enemy without his sight.
